title: euploca humistrata
intro: Euploca humistrata, commonly known as "Tecapán" or "Mexican Sage", is a flowering plant native to Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, colds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Euploca humistrata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Euploca humistrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
